worldcombat.skill.snipeshot.summary: Lock onto one chosen foe and fire a homing jet that passes through anything in the way: only the marked target takes damage, so other bodies and front ranks cannot draw the shot. A natural high-crit move; Deadeye shoots further and harder but slower.
worldcombat.skill.snipeshot.use.0: Reach over the front rank to a chosen back-line target
worldcombat.skill.snipeshot.use.1: Hit one named target in a crowd without being pulled off it
Hitting the locked target deals about %1$s special damage; the move has a natural high crit rate, and the target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
Range %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s-block hit radius; the jet passes through %4$s bodies on the way while only harming the locked one.
Turn up to %1$s degrees per tick to track the locked target.
worldcombat.skill.snipeshot.option.on: Deadeye: windup +4 ticks, range +3 blocks, power x1.15 and cooldown +6 ticks - shoots further and harder but slower.
worldcombat.skill.snipeshot.option.off: Quick shot: base windup and cooldown, slightly shorter range, power x1 - a faster hand for self-defence.
worldcombat.skill.snipeshot.timing: Range %1$s blocks; windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.snipeshot.growth.0: At level %1$s the shot rises to %2$s power and the range to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.snipeshot.preference.d: On (Deadeye): windup +4 ticks, range +3 blocks, power x1.15 and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (Quick shot): a faster hand and shorter cooldown, with slightly less range and power.
worldcombat.skill.snipeshot.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; higher opens from further away.
On: prefer to fire when another foe stands near the target - the shot passes through the front rank to the back. Off: rank like any other ranged attack.
On: low-health targets rank higher for a finishing shot. Off: all targets rank the same.
